expectations.buyer: Data-centre, battery, and industrial developers; landowners; utilities; economic-development agencies; brokers; and infrastructure financiers
expectations.pain: A site is marketed as grid-ready but capacity, upgrade cost, energisation schedule, queue identity, land control, and load behavior are not bankable together
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Utility capacity maps and queues, site-selection consultants, economic-development agencies, land brokers, interconnection studies, and developer diligence
expectations.biggestRisk: Capacity truth is utility-owned and time-varying, public maps carry disclaimers, speculative listings distort supply, and a marketplace cannot guarantee energisation
